shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with a large curved head shown in profile
beak-like or hooked projecting head form
curving crest/eye spiral motif on the head
block of parallel ribbed/comb-like lines below the head (fingers or feathers)
rounded, bulging body masses with curved outlines
relief figure occupying nearly the whole field
second partial figure/face at the edge (B) comparable to repeated carved heads
justification: Both show a single large hybrid bird-headed anthropomorph filling the field, with a hooked/beaked profile head bearing curved eye-and-crest scrolls above a distinctive block of parallel ribbed lines standing for fingers or feathers, and rounded bulging body volumes outlined in bold curves — an unusually specific combination. The main differences are that A elaborates the body with rows of circles/ovals and clearly articulated wing-arms and a torso in profile, while B's figure is reduced to a few massive lobes with no circle motifs and no legible limbs, so the specific attributes cannot be matched one to one.
